title: Vivino: Drink The Right Wine
description:
Vivino helps you discover, choose, and buy the right wine.

Join over 70 million wine lovers who use Vivino to scan labels, track their tastes with ratings,  and buy wines directly in the app.

From casual sippers to seasoned collectors, Vivino makes it easy to explore the world of wine with millions of ratings and reviews across 16 million wines, 245,000 wineries, and over 500 shoppable merchants.

Scan, Search, and Find Your Next Favorite
ΓÇó Snap a photo of any wine label to unlock ratings, reviews, tasting notes, and food pairings
ΓÇó Scan full restaurant wine lists to quickly spot the best bottles for your taste
ΓÇó Search by grape, region, style, or dish ΓÇô from Cabernet to Caldo Verde

Buy the Right Wine
ΓÇó Shop for wine directly in the app from VivinoΓÇÖs vetted network of top-rated wine merchants
ΓÇó Get personalized wine picks based on your taste and insights from 70 million wine lovers
ΓÇó Get money off your first order just for giving us a try

Understand your Tastes
ΓÇó Record which styles, grapes, and regions you love (or loathe!)
ΓÇó Get personalized suggestions based on your wine ratings and preferences
ΓÇó See a ΓÇÿMatch for YouΓÇÖ score for whether youΓÇÖll like the wine or not

Your Personal Wine Journal
ΓÇó Keep a record of every wine youΓÇÖve tried, with your own ratings, reviews, and notes
ΓÇó Mark wines as favorites and track the memories tied to each bottles

Track Your Collection
ΓÇó Add bottles to your cellar to keep track of what you own and when to drink them
ΓÇó Sort by quantity, vintage, or drinking status to manage your collection over time

Join the WorldΓÇÖs Largest Wine Community
 ΓÇó Learn from 70 million wine lovers who share real reviews, photos, and insights
 ΓÇó Follow friends and experts to discover new favorites
 ΓÇó Share your own experiences through ratings, photos, and tasting notes

Stay in the Know
 ΓÇó Get alerts for discounts, personalized picks, and order updates
 ΓÇó Receive weekly highlights with new wines that match your profile

From scanning to sipping, Vivino is your one-stop shop for discovering, learning about, and enjoying the right wine for every occasion.

What's new:
- Your taste profile got a refresh. See your taste for Red, White, Ros├⌐, Sparkling, Fortified and Dessert. Each with its own taste scales and styles/regions/grapes breakdown. Tap Edit preferences if we got you wrong.
- Your digital Cellar got a big upgrade. Get a complete overview of your wines broken down type, grapes, regions and drinking windows
- Your personal AI Sommelier got a facelift. It's now quicker to respond, knows more about your history and has a new look.
